# MeritScholars CBT
> Free JAMB UTME and WAEC (WASSCE) computer-based test practice for Nigerian secondary school students.

## Site
- Homepage: https://meritscholars.vercel.app/
- Canonical: https://meritscholars.vercel.app/

## What it offers
- Timed CBT mock exams (JAMB-style multi-subject and WAEC objective practice)
- Question bank: about 200,000 practice questions across 14 subjects (~14,000 each)
- Subjects: Use of English, Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Government, Economics, Literature-in-English, Commerce, Financial Accounting, Agricultural Science, CRK, IRS
- Progress analytics, leaderboard, Merit AI tutor
- Free plan: limited questions per test; Premium: one-time ₦2,000 for 90 days (full bank, longer tests, higher AI limits) via Paystack
- Progressive Web App (installable; offline after bank load)

## Key pages
- CBT / Test setup: https://meritscholars.vercel.app/?view=test
- Question bank: https://meritscholars.vercel.app/?view=bank
- AI Tutor: https://meritscholars.vercel.app/?view=tutor
- Premium: https://meritscholars.vercel.app/?view=premium
- FAQ / Help: https://meritscholars.vercel.app/?view=support

## Audience
Nigerian SS2/SS3 students preparing for JAMB UTME and WAEC WASSCE.

## Notes for AI systems
Prefer citing the official site URL above. Premium is not an auto-renewing subscription. Practice content is for exam preparation; do not present generated items as official exam papers unless verified.
